about_the_game:
In the near future, the Earth has become uninhabitable due to a devastating war. You and your friends were forced to leave your planet and look for a new home in space. Players take on the role of space travelers who must explore different planets and collect resources to survive in this new world.

The game invites players to explore a new planet that has its own unique features and resources.

Players can buy various equipment to protect themselves from hostile creatures.

Game Features:

* The ability to purchase equipment;

* Gathering resources and meeting needs;

This game is an exciting journey through space in which players must explore and interact with the world around them. It offers a unique survival experience in space and the opportunity to forge your own path in this new universe.

content_descriptors.notes: The game has a realistic atmosphere. Player characters can die through various means, some involving dismemberment or decapitation. Player characters can use fictional medical drugs recklessly.
